mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO afv_media_blob_cleanup(blob_id,status,eligible_at,next_attempt_at,created_at,updated_at) SELECT b.id,'WAITING',TIMESTAMPADD(DAY,#{days},b.orphaned_at),TIMESTAMPADD(DAY,#{days},b.orphaned_at),UTC_TIMESTAMP(6),UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) FROM afv_media_blob b WHERE b.state='ORPHAN' AND b.orphaned_at IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM afv_media_blob_cleanup c WHERE c.blob_id=b.id) ORDER BY b.orphaned_at,b.id LIMIT 100
mapper.select: SELECT blob_id FROM afv_media_blob_cleanup WHERE status<>'PURGED' AND next_attempt_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND eligible_at<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ORDER BY next_attempt_at,blob_id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE afv_media_blob_cleanup SET status='WAITING',owner_id=NULL,lease_until=NULL,next_attempt_at=TIMESTAMPADD(MINUTE,#{minutes},UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)),last_error='存储文件清理未完成，将自动重试；请检查存储配置',updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE blob_id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT owner_id,epoch,status,lease_until>UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AS valid FROM afv_media_blob_cleanup WHERE blob_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
